relations: Ophelia 与 Dante 是 mate；他唤她 Angel；她脖带 Reaper 掐的淤青。
Reaper 多年缓慢撕裂监狱魔法，几乎毁掉她立的全部规则。
Dante 从 River 处得知结构损伤，宣布亲自带队处理 Reaper，不许她再下监狱。
Dante 宣布搬进她的住所同床共枕，行李已候门外。

facts.fact: 她在 Dante 胸口醒来，他目光落在颈上淤青，怒火顺 bond 翻涌。
facts.anchor: His gaze dipped to the bruises around my throat, and his anger swelled, rolling through the bond

facts.fact: 她把 Dante 不在场时发生的一切讲给他听。
facts.anchor: I quietly told him about everything he hadn’t been there for

facts.fact: 她报告：Reaper 缓慢撕裂+她此番解编，剩余规则多半已毁，电梯是最后防线。
facts.anchor: Reaper has been tearing it away slowly. It's pretty bad. With all of the unraveling I just did

facts.fact: Dante 禁止她在清空前再下去，宣布亲自带队处理 Reaper。
facts.anchor: Not until it's empty. I'll lead the group myself to deal with Reaper. You're not going back

facts.fact: 怒气量表：A solid nine；下电梯之前是 eleven。
facts.anchor: I was an eleven before I made it down that elevator

facts.fact: Dante 宣布不再给空间：搬进来同住同床共享生活。
facts.anchor: There will be no more space," he stated. "I'll be living here with you. Sharing a bed with you

facts.fact: 他抚她的淤青威胁：再敢独自冒险就锁进这栋房子。
facts.anchor: If you ever risk yourself without me there to protect you again, I will lock you in this house

facts.fact: 她走出视线后靠墙，消化他要搬进来、让她喜欢上 mate 关系的决定。
facts.anchor: I leaned heavily against the wall after I was out of his sight, separating myself from the gigantic vampire
